I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: The job agent issues a call for proposal (CFP) for its operation to all possible machine agents.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Job agents learn which dispatching rule to use through contextual bandit RL (LinUCB). A central manager agent handles registration and finds capable machines. Combined processing is modeled as virtual operations led by a master operation. There is no formal model-based representation and no replanning when disruptions occur.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The operation with a small job number is the master operation, and it is responsible for the decision of the virtual operation scheduling.
